name: Steve Matteson
bio: Steve Matteson is a type designer whose work quietly powers billions of screens and printed pages worldwide. Over three decades, he has crafted fonts for some of the most recognizable technology and consumer brands—Microsoft’s Segoe, Google’s Droid and Noto, Toyota, Unilever, Xbox, and Rocket Mortgage, among many others. Whether working on a global corporate type system or a rare historical revival, Steve brings an artist’s eye, an engineer’s precision, and an educator’s passion to every project.
